title: Australia went to war with emus... and lost #history #shorts
description: In 1932 Major Meredith's soldiers took two Lewis guns and 10,000 rounds to fight emus damaging wheat farms in Western Australia. He claimed 986 kills from 9,860 rounds. Sources: Britannica, Wikipedia, National Geographic.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: In nineteen thirty two, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight emus. And the emus won.
scenes.title: THE GREAT EMU WAR

scenes.speaker: f
scenes.say: Roughly twenty thousand emus were trampling wheat farms in Western Australia.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: So Major Meredith showed up with two Lewis guns and ten thousand rounds of ammo.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: But the emus just scattered. One gun jammed after a few rounds, and after three days only about thirty birds were down.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: By December, Meredith claimed nine hundred eighty six emus, using almost ten thousand rounds. About ten bullets per bird.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: The soldiers went home. The emus stayed. Team soldiers or team emus? Comment below.
